materials: biopsy specimens from liver, heart, kidney, and pancreas
actions.notes: Specimens from four SARS-CoV-2 patients and four non-COVID-19 patients were selected, matched for age and sex, and provided by the Biobank of the Liege University Hospital.
Staining was done prior to selection by two pathologists.
Retrospective analysis of the last available blood sample taken within 24 hours preceding the patient's death was conducted by the central laboratory of the Liege University Hospital.
Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue sections of 4 µm were cut for histological and immunofluorescence examination.
Use a Pannoramic 250 Flash III Scanner for digitization.
Two experienced pathologists assessed high-resolution images focusing on NET areas using a scoring system for lesions typically found in SARS-CoV-2 diffuse alveolar damage.

materials: rabbit anti-human citrullinated histone H3 antibodies
actions.notes: Deparaffinize, rehydrate, and boil tissue sections for antigen retrieval. Permeabilize, block, and stain with primary and secondary antibodies. Mount with ProLong Antifade reagent and store overnight.
Use standard filter sets for analysis.
Stain with secondary antibodies after incubation with host species sera without primary antibodies to check for nonspecific fluorescent staining.

actions.description: Scan the cloned HAG maize CoREGs for the presence of an acetyl-CoA-binding site using the Conserved Domain Database (CDD).
Use the region of approximately 75–90 amino acids as the operational taxonomic unit for phylogenetic analysis.
Align related proteins using Clustal W with default parameters implemented using the megalign program within the dnastar Lasergene package.
Align AUX/IAA CoREGs FL amino acid sequences using MUSCLE with default parameters.
Export each multiple sequence alignment in Newick format.
Display phylogenetic trees using FigTree V1.4.0.
Clone constructs into either the pENTR/D-TOPO or pENTR/SD/D-TOPO vector.
Amplify targeted TF or CoREG ORFs using high-fidelity Phusion polymerase with the manufacturer's GC buffer supplemented with 10% glycerol.
Optimize amplification by adding up to 10% DMSO, up to 4 mM MgCl2 or adjusting the annealing temperature if necessary.
Design primers to produce a fragment without a stop codon and with a 5'-CACC nucleotide tailing added to the forward primer for directional cloning into the pENTR vectors.
Screen kanamycin-resistant colonies for inserts of the correct size and orientation by colony PCR or by restriction digestion of candidate plasmids.
Confirm the sequence of cloned inserts by single-read paired-end Sanger dideoxy sequencing.
Design internal primers to complete the sequence confirmation for clones longer than 1200 bp.
Grow the B73 inbred of maize in a field nursery and isolate DNA for PCR amplification of single-exon genes or RNA for RT-PCR.
Determine codon optimization strategy for synthesized ORFs by analyzing pENTRSD/D-TOPO clones harboring synthesized coding sequences optimized according to maize, yeast or hybrid preference.
Use LR Clonase to recombine these CDSs into a GAL4-BD-GWC1 vector to fuse them with the yeast GAL4-binding domain or to generate N-terminal fusions with GFP into plasmid p1511.
Transform PJ69.4a yeast cells with each GAL4-BD-GWC1 construct using the lithium acetate/single-stranded carrier DNA/polyethylene glycol method.
Prepare protein samples from yeast cells for Western blot analysis.
Perform Western blot analysis using the prepared protein samples.
Digest maize leaves to prepare protoplasts for transformation.
Electroporate protoplasts with DNA for transient luciferase assays and transient complementation assays.
Estimate transformation efficiency following GFP expression under a fluorescence microscope.
Quantify fluorescence using intensity measurement of the entire protoplast area using Image J software.
Isolate genomic DNA from B73 plant tissue using a CTAB-based method.
Isolate total RNA from non-starchy B73 tissues using RNAzol according to the manufacturer's suggested protocol.
Isolate RNA from starchy tissues such as developing seeds using a modified protocol.
Verify RNA integrity by agarose gel electrophoresis and ethidium bromide staining.
Treat total RNA samples with Turbo DNA-free to remove any contaminating DNA.
Synthesize complementary DNA using Maxima H Minus Reverse Transcriptase.
Verify the integrity of cDNA by amplifying a portion of a Zm GAPDH transcript.
Perform RT-PCR on tissues where TFs are expected to be most highly expressed.
